document.title: Louisiana Public Service Commission Jurisdictional Electric Utilities Residential Bill Comparison, November 2026
document.assumptions: Bills for the November 2026 billing month, so each schedule's November energy rate and adjustment factors apply. Whether taxes are included is unstated; municipal franchise fee riders charged in some towns are not included (the report's notes for Pointe Coupee and Washington-St. Tammany). The report says it was compiled from information the utilities provided and that the Commission does not attest to its accuracy.
document.terms: The Commission's disclaimer limits its liability and states no restriction on reuse. The figures and line items are kept here, each with its page.

methods: word positions under the column headers
